title: FM27 Free Play — Launch Preview Dates, Access & Save Carryover
description: Play Football Manager 27 free until 3 November 2026 at 18:00 GMT. Official PC/Mac links, how access works afterwards, and confirmation that saves carry over.
meta: Updated 30 October 2026 · PC/Mac Launch Preview · Access details checked against Sports Interactive's announcement.
body:
Football Manager 27 is free to play on PC and Mac until 3 November 2026 at 18:00 GMT. Download the Launch Preview from an official platform below. All game modes are included, and Sports Interactive confirms that saves continue into the paid Preview and full release.

Where to download the free Launch Preview

PlatformOfficial entry pointAccess check
SteamFootball Manager 27 on SteamOpen the listing in Steam and choose the free-play option available during the window.
Epic Games StoreFM27 Launch PreviewUse the Preview listing linked by Sports Interactive.
Microsoft Store / PC Game PassFM27 Launch PreviewThe announcement specifies Xbox Game Pass Ultimate or PC Game Pass for subscription access.

The official announcement describes free PC/Mac play; availability depends on the selected store and operating system. This does not establish a free Console, Mobile or Touch edition.

Start playing

  1. Open an official platform link above, sign in to that platform if required, and select its Launch Preview or free-play option.
  2. Check the listing's operating-system and hardware requirements before installing.
  3. Download the game and start a save. Sports Interactive says there is no additional Preview sign-up.

We checked the published access instructions, not an installation on every platform. If the free-play option is missing, consult the current store listing and official announcement rather than purchasing on the assumption that the free offer will be applied later.

When does free play end?

StageTimeAccess
Free Launch Preview29 October, 18:00 GMT–3 November, 18:00 GMTFree-play window on the announced platforms.
Paid Launch PreviewAfter 3 November, 18:00 GMT, until 10 NovemberPre-purchase through a SEGA-approved digital retailer; eligible Game Pass subscribers can continue through their subscription.
Full launch10 November 2026Purchased game or applicable subscription. The end of free play is not the end of Preview access for eligible players.

The free window closes at 02:00 on 4 November in UTC+8 (Hong Kong / Beijing). GMT is UTC+0; use the stated GMT time when checking your local deadline.

Will my FM27 Preview save carry over?

Yes. Sports Interactive explicitly states that all saves started during free play can continue through the paid Launch Preview and full launch without starting again. Continued access after the free period still requires an eligible purchase or subscription.

Is this the FM27 beta or a permanent demo?

The official name is Launch Preview. It replaces what Sports Interactive previously called Beta / Advanced Access. The announcement offers a five-day free window, not a promise of a permanently free edition or recurring free weekends.

Preview data can change

Some Preview information is still awaiting rights-holder approval. Club and player assets may be absent and data may change. Check the game build and source date before relying on a player price, tactic or downloadable pack.
